retention_record.initial_record_note: The initial stdout field independent_metadata_copies counted all non-TIFF files (PNG masks plus JSON), not JSON alone. This audited record corrects the label; original stdout and JSON remain preserved.
retention_record.limitations: This retains files if temporary directory names are removed. It is not an independent backup: an in-place write to an image changes both linked names.
retention_record.storage: Persistent hardlinks retain TIFF image inputs on the same filesystem; PNG masks and JSON metadata are independently copied. All original source bytes and paths remain unchanged.

basis: All1533 cleaned training tiles already contribute to normalization or validation in each recorded seed;128 optimization tiles are a separate cap.
All205 cleaned test tiles were evaluated in15 current primary replays and previous campaigns, and their outcomes informed subsequent research.
The retained1937-pair raw corpus contains duplicate/leaked/conflicting-label exclusions, rather than a verified independent held-out event reserve.
No scene/event/acquisition/geographic IDs are present in retained manifest fields or metadata sidecars; TIFF scan findings are listed separately.
conclusion.limits: This does not assert that no unseen DFC24 data exist elsewhere. No remote/organizer source or unrelated home directory was inspected.
conclusion.statement: No verifiably untouched, reliably labeled scene/event partition was identified within this retained local DFC24 archive.

exposure.not_an_untouched_reserve: A tile absent from the128-image optimization subset may still have been used for normalization, validation, other seeds or historical experiments.

geo_cluster.clustering: Seeded k-means on standardized feature vectors, followed by a minimum-client-size guard that can move individual tiles.
geo_cluster.conclusion: Feature-distribution/client silos are not a geographic/event-independent holdout. Similar features do not identify common or independent events, and current validation is label-stratified rather than event-grouped.
geo_cluster.feature_definition: Three channel means plus three channel standard deviations plus mask flood fraction (7-D).

identity.qualification: Current path existence and manifest-byte identity checked here. The3476 raw-image/mask byte verification is prior producer/collector evidence; this audit does not relabel metadata reconstruction as a fresh full-byte rehash.

prospective_group_holdout.exposure_limit: Recovering metadata cannot retroactively make the existing corpus untouched. A fresh-holdout claim additionally needs documented data/outcomes not previously used in research decisions.
prospective_group_holdout.if_mapping_unavailable: A fixed feature-cluster or random split can be described as a prospective stress test on previously exposed DFC24, not fresh geographic/event confirmation.
prospective_group_holdout.safe_path: Recover an authoritative tile-to-scene/event/acquisition map and verify it against this manifest before defining a group-disjoint split. Recompute normalization on training groups only and preserve all prior-exposure disclosure.

scope.metadata_scan: Stdlib seek/read of TIFF/BigTIFF IFD chains and small metadata tags only; no raster arrays
